title: Mounted Stantler keeps nearby terrain loaded after the long route

verification.expectationSource: documentation/overworld-system/README.md#system-contracts and the measured mounted Stantler 840-frame terrain-loss reproduction
verification.actor: One prepared current Mounted Stantler (species 234, party slot 0, level 10) with an attached presentation on map 33
verification.trigger: Hold RIGHT, RIGHT, UP, LEFT, LEFT, UP and DOWN for exactly 120 completed frames each; read nearby loaded terrain; hold RIGHT for 120 more frames and read terrain again
verification.observable: The 840-frame endpoint stays near (576,397..398) with all nine radius-one terrain cells loaded. RIGHT recovery moves at least eight tiles east and all 25 radius-two terrain cells are loaded.

setupMutations.change: Teleport to map 33 (585,402), prepare party slot 0 as level-10 Stantler, mount it and bind its current actor. Do not edit movement, terrain, profile, chain state or input during observation.

limits: This tests the exact seven-leg 840-frame reproduction and one 120-frame RIGHT recovery, not every map or mounted Pokemon.
Paused endpoint terrain probes do not prove that all nearby tiles stayed loaded on every intermediate frame.
Prepared party and location do not prove natural selection, capture or spawning.

events.value: Prepare and bind the current mounted Stantler at map 33 (585,402)
Run the exact seven 120-frame cardinal holds: RIGHT RIGHT UP LEFT LEFT UP DOWN
Read the radius-one terrain grid, then hold RIGHT 120 frames and read radius two

stop.condition: All 960 route and recovery frames complete, both native loaded-terrain neighborhoods are present, and RIGHT recovery advances

invariants: The same current Mounted Stantler remains attached throughout the route
The route endpoint has nine loaded native terrain cells and the recovery endpoint has 25
RIGHT recovery moves at least eight tiles east from the route endpoint
No active actors share a nonzero target reservation
Every active actor handle uses the current field epoch
